decisions.Kwic: 譬如蒸砂作飯，豈療飢瘡？掘地覓天，莫覩霄漢。

Decision.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Chijue Daochong (痴絕道冲禪師語錄). Chijue Daochong is the exact speaker of the uninterrupted instruction: he compares intentional investigation and verbal theorizing to steaming sand to make rice and digging into earth to seek heaven.
